writeup.key_factor: The goaltending gap is real and confirmed: Florida's starter Jacob Markstrom is on IR, so backup Akira Schmid (3.24 GAA, .876 SV%) starts, while Ottawa counters with Linus Ullmark (6-1-0, 1.33 GAA, .945 SV%). Florida is also missing Barkov and Marchand (IR), top defenseman Jake Sanderson returns for Ottawa, and the price improved to -102 at Novig against our fair line of -127.
writeup.risk: The NHL rating is still last season's final Elo and does not yet reflect this season's games, so the 55.9% carries early-season uncertainty. Schmid has historically played well against Ottawa (1.73 GAA in 3 appearances), and Florida has won three straight despite the injuries — pass if the price drops below -108, where the edge falls under the 4% NHL gate.

writeup.key_factor: GOLD via the 60% rule (Alex's commercial Gold rule — this play enters on model probability, not on the Scanner edge gate). The model gives the Lakers a 71.6% win probability, and the context is confirmed at midday: Golden State is officially without Jimmy Butler (ACL), Kristaps Porzingis, Moses Moody and Brandin Podziemski, and Stephen Curry is only probable on a sore right ankle with managed minutes. The Lakers are nearly whole — Walker Kessler cleared, Luka Doncic healthy. Price -203 at Novig (Pinnacle -217 is the best API book).
writeup.risk: The +4.6 edge does NOT clear the Scanner's early-season bar (5.0 pts) and -203 sits outside the preferred -110 to -165 Gold price band — this is a probability play for the free members' record, not a value play. The NBA model is still a cold seed with no 2026-27 games, and Curry is expected to play; if he is a full-go, the true probability is lower than 71.6%. Pass if the price drops below -214, where the edge falls under the base 3.5% NBA gate.
